card.name: Inside long drug and proper names
card.fires_on: A piece in the middle of a long, rare drug brand or generic name (e.g. ROZLYTREK, Ustekinumab, enoxaparin-like names). It also fires inside long foreign place or person names split into parts.

modes.label: Brand and generic drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of a long drug name split into several parts, such as the T in ROZLYTREK.
modes.example: withhold ROZLY<<T>>REK until improvement or stabilization

modes.label: Rare proper names
modes.description: Middle piece of a long place, person or church name outside drug text.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated odd fragments, so no clear output effect beyond continuing a multi-part name.
card.plain: It lights up partway through a long, unusual name, especially a drug name that is broken into pieces.
